merges.sentence: Instructors state in each assignment whether and how AI may be used.
merges.why: Both have instructors mark per-assignment AI rules in the instructions.

merges.sentence: Instructors may question students live or in interviews to check they understand their code.
merges.why: All use live questioning of students to verify understanding of their work.

merges.sentence: Instructors refer suspected AI misuse to formal academic integrity or disciplinary processes.
merges.why: All route AI misuse through formal misconduct reporting channels.

merges.sentence: Instructors base grades on proctored, controlled assessments rather than unproctored code work.
merges.why: Both shift assessment weight to supervised settings.
